popCulture.title: Iliad
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Book III's Teichoscopia — Thymoetes sits with Priam among the Trojan elders at the Scaean gates when Helen comes to the wall.

popCulture.title: Aeneid
popCulture.creator: Virgil
popCulture.description: Virgil's Thymoetes urges the Trojans to haul the wooden horse inside the walls — the counsellor whose voice helps seal Troy's fall.

popCulture.title: Thymoetes
popCulture.description: Trojan elder of the Iliad and Aeneid — distinct from Thymoetes the last Athenian king of the same name.
